# All-maker.com

> Personal site of Strahinja Milošević, Senior Technical Writer. Covers technical writing craft, career, and leadership, alongside hands-on making: metalworking, leatherworking, and cooking.

- Portfolio: https://strahinjamilosevic.com/
- Resume: https://all-maker.com/strahinja_milosevic_cv.pdf
- RSS feed: https://all-maker.com/blog/rss.xml

## Blog

- [About this blog](https://all-maker.com/blog/intro/): Why I made this website and what to expect.
- [Pizza](https://all-maker.com/blog/pizza/): Technical writing as a craft, told through the metaphor of making pizza.
- [Tech bro VS caveman](https://all-maker.com/blog/tech-bro/): Technology overload and coping mechanisms.
- [Use cheap tools until they break](https://all-maker.com/blog/cheap-tools/): Invest in foundational skills before you get lost in the whirlpool of tooling options.
- [Arguing with a robot](https://all-maker.com/blog/argue-with-robot/): Using AI as a conversational sparring partner.
- [Tech and art](https://all-maker.com/blog/tech-art/): The relationship between technical work and creative expression.
- [Alien tech writer](https://all-maker.com/blog/alien/): What it feels like to be a technical writer.
- [Redefining technical writing](https://all-maker.com/blog/redefining-technical-writing/): Designing knowledge flows and how the product behaves is now the job.
- [Life is an MVP](https://all-maker.com/blog/mvp/): A minimum viable product is not a dirty word. It is an instrument of evolution.
- [Tech writing career ladder](https://all-maker.com/blog/career/): What seniority means, and how to advance on your technical writing journey.
- [Emotional durability in leadership](https://all-maker.com/blog/emotional-durability/): Why emotional endurance matters in leadership.
- [Why all-maker](https://all-maker.com/blog/all-maker/): Where I come from and how I came to be who I am.
- [Docs-as-code is not development](https://all-maker.com/blog/docs-as-code-not-dev/): Using the same tools does not mean every project is the same.
- [Forget cheat sheets, work with people](https://all-maker.com/blog/cheat-sheets/): Job searching has become a part-time job. Here is what actually matters.
- [Validation craving in a thankless job](https://all-maker.com/blog/validation/): Stop expecting a pat on the back. Change the paradigm instead.
- [Discovering technical writers](https://all-maker.com/blog/discover-tech-writers/): A mental model for hiring technical writers across specializations.
- [Coding is harder, right?](https://all-maker.com/blog/coding-is-harder/): Why we assumed coding was harder than writing, and why core writing skills matter more than tools.

## Resources

- [Get started with technical writing](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/get-started-with-technical-writing/): A presentation about what technical writing is and isn't, and where to start.
- [API governance framework](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/api-governance/): A framework for designing and documenting APIs, with the decisions every team needs to make, examples, and templates to record them.
- [Docs project management](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/docs-pm-framework/): A framework for embedding documentation into planning, development, UAT, and release processes. Work in progress.
- [Why build better docs](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/docs-business-case/): A practical framework for convincing decision makers to invest in documentation, with examples of good docs, a simple way to prioritize, ways to measure results, and a proposal template.
- [Talks](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/talks/): Talks, presentations, and recordings about technical writing, documentation, and AI.
- [Job search](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/job-application/job-search/): How to research, prepare, and present yourself to get the job you want.
  - [Research the company](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/job-application/research-the-company/): How to research a company and role before you apply.
  - [Tailor the resume](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/job-application/tailor-the-resume/): How to structure and write a resume that gets you in the room.
  - [Build a portfolio](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/job-application/build-a-portfolio/): How to create and host a portfolio site for free.
  - [Write the cover letter](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/job-application/write-the-cover-letter/): How to write a cover letter that makes you stand out.
  - [Prepare for the interviews](https://all-maker.com/docs/resources/job-application/prepare-for-interviews/): How to prepare for each round of the interview process.

## Crafting projects

- [Introduction](https://all-maker.com/docs/intro/): Overview of what I am making.
- [Metalworking](https://all-maker.com/docs/metalworking/): Welding and blacksmithing projects.
  - [Welding projects](https://all-maker.com/docs/metalworking/welding/): Home workshop projects with a stick welder, from a first weld to furniture.
  - [Blacksmithing workshop](https://all-maker.com/docs/metalworking/blacksmithing/): Forging a knife over four sessions at a traditional forge in Amsterdam.
- [Leatherworking](https://all-maker.com/docs/leatherworking/): My journey into leatherworking.
- [Cooking: Lebanese flatbreads](https://all-maker.com/docs/cooking/flatbreads/): An easy, family flatbread recipe.
